versions.subject: rule: suspicious compression tool parameters
versions.detection:
selection:
    OriginalFileName:
        - '7z*.exe'
        - '*rar.exe'
        - '*Command*Line*RAR*'
    CommandLine:
        - '* -p*'
        - '* -ta*'
        - '* -tb*'
        - '* -sdel*'
        - '* -dw*'
        - '* -hp*'
falsepositive:
    ParentImage: 'C:\Program*'
condition: selection and not falsepositive
versions.spl: OriginalFileName IN ("7z*.exe", "*rar.exe", "*Command*Line*RAR*") CommandLine IN ("* -p*", "* -ta*", "* -tb*", "* -sdel*", "* -dw*", "* -hp*") NOT ParentImage="C:\\Program*"
